I believe that language learning happens fastest when we enjoy the material and it's relevant to our lives. I will teach whatever topics interest my students - Cooking, Literature, Fashion, Video Games - Anything is okay!

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation - Get the job you deserve - All industries
pro_course_detail.description:
I will get you ready for your job interview, no matter your industry or country. 

I have successfully completed many job interviews in the USA (Hollywood, Silicon Valley), South Korea and Mexico. I also have over 20 years of experience in preparing people for their job interviews, in fields/roles including flight attendant, IT, Business Management, supervisory roles, Masters and Ph.D. programs, education and many more.

- CV and resume review (only during our class). 
- Mock interviews and role-plays. 
- Professional and suitable vocabulary. 
- Confidence and attitude. 
- Behavior, such as greeting, body language, and etiquette.

In the same way that I have helped actors make it onto the big screen working in Hollywood, I will get you ready for the most important conversation of your life. 

As with all my students, you will be my main focus from the moment we start taking classes together to the moment you get your dream job and beyond. If you would like to get to know me first, feel free to book a trial lesson anytime.

	•	Building a strong foundation in essential vocabulary
	•	Improving pronunciation and listening skills
	•	Practicing simple and/or advanced sentence structures through interactive dialogues
